title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An Agency detective whose magic recreates what he has seen, who seeks an analysis of the strange powder and rescues Kylox.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin with psychic abilities who now accompanies Proft and breaks an attacker's fugue.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: A paranoid red viashino Izzet inventor and Proft's friend, who is killed by a drugged attacker.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin who has Kylox kidnapped to learn what he knows about the killings, fearing he is next.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker leading the investigation who is ambushed with Kellan and then argues for time.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young Agency investigator who fights with elemental swords and finds white fur on a dissolved attacker's robe.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros warleader who accuses the Cult of Rakdos but grants Kaya twenty-four hours.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The archon head of the Agency who informs Kaya that Teysa's killer has been arrested.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A ghost Boros investigator who backs Kaya's request for time.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos assassin who attacked Aurelia and killed ten of her guards, with no memory of it.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The murdered Orzhov leader.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The Rakdos figure Kaya and Kellan interviewed.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane.

entities.name: Kylox's workshop
entities.description: A small Izzet workshop trashed by intruders, with a hidden trapdoor.

entities.name: Boilerpits
entities.description: Hot, fragrant tunnels of pipes and steam vents beneath the Izzet district.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Where Teysa was killed.

entities.name: Eighth District
entities.description: The district where the arrested hitman last remembers walking.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The investigative body led by Ezrim.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The enforcement guild led by Aurelia.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law guild that holds the arrested hitman.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild Aurelia blames.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Etrata's guild, whose members are missing.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of inventors to which Kylox belongs.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A guild in self-imposed exile.

events.summary: Etrata pins Proft against a wall and demands to know where they are going.
events.quote: All will be clear right now, or we're not going any farther.

events.summary: Proft explains the powder needs analysis by someone trustworthy.
events.quote: The powder I found in your chamber is like nothing I've encountered before.

events.summary: They find Kylox's workshop door unlocked, which is unusual.
events.quote: That's unusual. He never leaves the door unlocked.

events.summary: The workshop is revealed to be destroyed as if by a gang.
events.quote: It looked as if an entire gang of people had passed through, smashing everything they could get their hands on.

events.summary: Proft's magic reconstructs the workshop to find what is out of place.
events.quote: The light pulsed, and the workshop was no longer destroyed.

events.summary: Etrata opens the hidden trapdoor by drumming a pattern.
events.quote: A square portion of floor dropped several inches with a loud click.

events.summary: They find Kylox writing furiously in a hidden chamber.
events.quote: was a red viashino, facial scales reflecting the pallid light of the lantern on the desk's edge.

events.summary: Kylox reveals he was working on something secret and will only tell Ezrim.
events.quote: Something no one was meant to know.

events.summary: Goblins chain and abduct Kylox as Proft and Etrata hide.
events.quote: The goblins produced thin lengths of mizzium chain, wrapping them around Kylox, who said nothing and only allowed himself to be taken.

events.summary: Proft takes a small wooden box from Kylox's shelf.
events.quote: he paused by the shelf Kylox had been next to, just long enough to grab a small, unornamented wooden box and tuck it under his arm.

events.summary: Kaya notices a crowd shifting abnormally and realizes she and Kellan are being followed.
events.quote: We're being followed.

events.summary: Six robed attackers ambush Kaya and Kellan in an alley.
events.quote: A group of six people in long, dark robes followed them, too quickly to have arrived by accident, and fanned out to surround the pair.

events.summary: A captured attacker swallows a green sprout and the others do the same.
events.quote: he shoved something that looked like a tiny green sprout into his mouth, triumph lighting up his eyes as he swallowed.

events.summary: The attackers dissolve into moss, leaving empty robes.
events.quote: the flesh of the man in front of her softened and turned green, growing plush as it transmuted into moss beneath her hand.

events.summary: Kellan finds a tuft of white fur on the robe.
events.quote: A tuft of white fur tipped in gray clung to the fabric.

events.summary: An Agency thopter relays Ezrim's order to secure the scene and return.
events.quote: Boros officers are on their way to your location.

events.summary: Ezrim tells Kaya that Teysa's killer has been caught by the Azorius.
events.quote: Teysa's killer has been apprehended by the Azorius.

events.summary: Ezrim explains the hitman remembers nothing but arriving covered in blood at Karlov Manor.
events.quote: One minute he was walking through the Eighth District, and the next, he was in Karlov Manor, covered in Teysa's blood.

events.summary: Aurelia drags in Massacre Girl, who attacked her and killed ten Boros guards.
events.quote: She killed ten of my guards before I stopped her.

events.summary: Aurelia declares the Cult of Rakdos is behind the killings and prepares to march.
events.quote: her presence proves the Cult of Rakdos is behind all this senseless slaughter.

events.summary: Massacre Girl says she has no memory of the attack.
events.quote: I don't remember anything before she was sweeping my legs out from under me

events.summary: Agrus Kos backs Kaya's plea and Aurelia grants twenty-four hours.
events.quote: Twenty-four hours, no more, and the assassin stays with us

events.summary: Kaya realizes the arrest means Teysa is truly gone.
events.quote: having a killer means this isn't a trick. Teysa's really gone.

events.summary: The goblin kidnappers carry Kylox to a pawnshop.
events.quote: the goblins carried Kylox to a disreputable-looking pawnshop.

events.summary: Krenko interrogates Kylox about the killings out of fear for himself.
events.quote: I know enough to know I'm at risk here. You're going to tell me everything you know.

events.summary: Etrata subdues Krenko's six guards.
events.quote: in moments, all six guards were on the ground, not moving.

events.summary: A drugged attacker crashes in, kills Kylox, and is subdued by Etrata.
events.quote: There was a strangled gasp as the viashino fell out of the way and slid, motionless, to the floor.

events.summary: Etrata breaks the attacker's fugue with her psychic gaze.
events.quote: he jerked back, pupils returning to a more normal state as he tried to recoil from her and the fear she had induced.

events.summary: Proft concludes that people are being brainwashed into attacks.
events.quote: People are being brainwashed into these attacks.

relations.quote: a thrashing woman in Rakdos colors

relations.note: attacked her and killed her guards

relations.quote: Alquist, thank you. I hoped you'd understand what I was asking for.
Kylox never leaves Izzet-controlled territory if he can help it
You sent me to oversee. I'm overseeing.
Why am I trying so hard to keep you alive?
These agents have been to see Judith of the Rakdos
